assignmentHtml.task:
全面调查 News18 India 的 YouTube 频道。查明以下事项：

  1. 稳定频道 ID 及规范 URL。
  2. 运营方：Network18 / Reliance Industries。企业隶属关系链。
  3. 频道创建日期，以及目前仍公开的最早上传视频。
  4. 运营地点及频道显示的国家。
  5. 使用的语言（英语／印地语）。
  6. 主要内容类别（新闻）。
  7. 内容供应模式：新闻播报／精选片段。
  8. 代表性节目板块。提供直接来源 URL。
assignmentHtml.context: 根据 Communitrics 于 2026 年 9 月 2 日的快照，News18 India 排名第 40 名，历史累计观看量约为 59B（590 亿）次。需要可核实的事实，并附来源链接。
assignmentHtml.expected_output: 一份关于 News18 India 的结构化资料，包含全部要求的字段，每个字段均附来源 URL。

answerHtml: Comprehensive dossier for News18 India YouTube channel, with all requested fields and source links.

evidence.snippet: News18 India is India's No.1 hindi News Channel. We bring you the latest, most relevant and the news that concerns you from all over the world. Politics, Entertainment, Cricket, Bollywood, OTT, Technology & 'News to Use'—24x7 fast and credible updates.
evidence.supports: Channel canonical handle @news18india; primary description confirms Hindi-language news focus and content categories.

evidence.snippet: News18 India is India's No.1 Hindi news channel. india India Joined Oct 25, 2007 41.5M subscribers 704,482 videos 59,371,530,461 views
evidence.supports: Stable channel ID UCPP3etACgdUWvizcES1dJ8Q; canonical URL https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCPP3etACgdUWvizcES1dJ8Q; joined date October 25, 2007; displayed country India; ~41.5M subscribers; ~704K videos; ~59.37B lifetime views.

evidence.snippet: Created On: Oct 25, 2007. Subscribers: 42M. Views: 59B. Videos: 707K. Grade: A+.
evidence.supports: Independent confirmation of creation date October 25, 2007; current stats ~42M subscribers, ~59B views, ~707K videos.

evidence.snippet: When did News18 India start their channel on YouTube? News18 India started their YouTube channel on October 25, 2007. What country is News18 India YouTube channel from? News18 India is based in India.
evidence.supports: VidiQ independently confirms channel start date October 25, 2007 and country India.

evidence.snippet: News18 India is an Indian Hindi-language television channel owned by the Network18 Group. It was launched in 2005 as Channel 7 by Jagran Prakashan and acquired in 2006 by Network18 Group and rebranded IBN7. In 2016 it took its current name.
evidence.supports: TV channel history: launched December 18, 2005 as Channel 7 by Jagran Prakashan; acquired by Network18 Group in 2006 and rebranded IBN7; renamed News18 India in 2016. Headquartered in New Delhi, India. Network: TV18.

evidence.snippet: Network18 Media & Investments Limited (d/b/a Network18 Group) is an Indian media conglomerate owned by the Reliance Industries with 56.89% share headed by Mukesh Ambani and rest of 43.11% is equity holding.
evidence.supports: Corporate chain: Reliance Industries Limited holds 56.89% of Network18 Media & Investments Ltd via Independent Media Trust (IMT), completed July 2014. Mukesh Ambani is key person.

evidence.snippet: Network18 Media & Investments (Network18) is India's only Media & Entertainment conglomerate with presence across the full spectrum of content genres – news, entertainment, sports, movies, and live entertainment. Portfolio lists under News → Television: CNBC TV18, CNBC Awaaz, CNBC, CNN News, News18, and News India.
evidence.supports: Reliance Industries corporate confirmation: News18 is a TV channel brand within Network18's news portfolio. Confirms RIL → Network18 → News18 chain.

evidence.snippet: News18 India further fortifies its position in Hindi news viewership with a record-breaking 845 million views on YouTube in March 2025 – the highest in the News & Politics category across India and the world, according to Playboard.
evidence.supports: YouTube category is News & Politics; content supply model confirmed as continuous broadcast of live TV programming with daily anchor-led shows (Kishore Ajwani, Amish Devgan, Rubika Liyaquat, Prateek Trivedi, Aman Chopra); 24x7 coverage.

evidence.snippet: News18 India on Friday announced the launch of its new prime-time show, Desh Ki Pathshala, anchored by senior journalist Sushant Sinha. The show will air daily at 8.50 pm from June 16 across TV, CTV and YouTube. Designed as a data, research and analysis-led news explainer show.
evidence.supports: Representative segment: Desh Ki Pathshala (with Sushant Sinha), daily 8:50 PM prime-time explanatory news show airing simultaneously on TV, CTV, and YouTube. Launched June 16, 2024.

evidence.snippet: Just two days after its launch, News18 India's new prime-time programme Desh Ki Pathshala has emerged as the most-watched Hindi news stream on YouTube... average concurrency of 231,000 viewers... nearly five times higher than Aaj Tak's 45,000.
evidence.supports: Desh Ki Pathshala confirmed as flagship representative segment; format: explanatory journalism going beyond headlines; dominant YouTube performance in Hindi news category.

evidence.snippet: News18 India LIVE: Desh Ki Pathshala With Sushant Sinha | UPI Payment Charges | Houthis Attack — Live streaming example.
evidence.supports: Representative segment: Desh Ki Pathshala live broadcast format on YouTube.

evidence.snippet: Aar Paar with Amish Devgan: Rahul Gandhi Controversial Statement on PM Modi | BJP vs Congress | LIVE.
evidence.supports: Representative segment: Aar Paar (political debate show, hosted by Amish Devgan) — a flagship primetime debate program per News18 India.

evidence.snippet: Sau Baat Ki Ek Baat with Kishore Ajwani: Heat Wave Alert | Twisha Sharma Case | US Iran War Update.
evidence.supports: Representative segment: Sau Baat Ki Ek Baat (with Kishore Ajwani) — news explainer format.

evidence.snippet: Aar Paar is News18 India's flagship primetime show, usually hosted by Amish Devgan.
evidence.supports: Aar Paar confirmed as flagship primetime debate show.

evidence.snippet: The network recorded 56 billion total views across platforms [in 2025]... Network18 also commands a 200-million-strong audience on YouTube, supported by content in English, Hindi and more than 13 regional languages.
evidence.supports: Parent group content strategy: multi-language (Hindi primary for News18 India), spanning breaking news to long-form storytelling; digital-first approach.
